_comment: Copy to config.json and fill in. Never commit real credentials. Command-line flags win over this file. Live bidding stays OFF until live_bidding.configured is true AND you run with --live --confirm.
tax_rate_note: Sales tax is NOT printed on PropertyRoom lot pages. Set this to the ship-to jurisdiction's combined rate. 0.10 is the demo assumption (Lynnwood, WA ~10%). If null, the agent holds every lot for a human.
pickup_cost_note: What it costs YOU to collect a Customer Pick-up lot (travel, towing), added to the pickup fee on the page. 0 if you are local. If null, the agent never chooses pickup and holds pickup-only lots for a human.

policy.tx_cap_note: PropertyRoom card/PayPal ceiling. At $5,000+ only wire transfer works; the agent never wires money on its own.

live_bidding.note: Set to true ONLY after registering a PropertyRoom account and putting a payment method on file. Even then, a bid needs --live --confirm on the command line, and the bid transport itself is not built yet.
